name: Bulwark
fantasy: The squad's shield. Holds the line, plants a banner, leaps in to save an ally at the edge.
silhouette: the shield shape and the banner

card.loop: Block to build Guard, then bash, charge or smash foes into walls or each other: Crushed stuns them and heals you.
card.dash: Whirl: a spinning dash that knocks foes aside; with the shield up, a Shield Charge.
card.passive: Guard from blocking (50 = Shield Slam); knock a foe into a wall or a foe: Crushed (stun, heal).
card.lmb: Tap: throw the mace (passes through, recall it); hold: a Crushing Blow that carries you on.
card.rmb: Hold to raise the shield and block; let go (or tap) to Bash.
card.e: Mending Ground: a healing burst at the lying mace (or your aim) after 1s.
card.r: Fissure: a crack runs forward and stuns, then the ground erupts and slows.

weapons.tower_shield: Throw the mace and call it back; hold for a Crushing Blow.
weapons.minigun: Spin up, then a hose of rounds.

passive.name: Guard
passive.desc: Damage your shield blocks becomes Guard (1 per 2 blocked, max 100); at 50 your Bash is a Shield Slam (push 12, stun 0.6, spends 50) and Fissure spends it all for +1 pulse per 50. Crushed: a Bash, Shield Charge or full Crushing Blow that knocks a foe into a wall or another foe stuns it 0.8 (8 damage) and heals you 14.

dash.name: Whirl
dash.desc: Whirl: a 3.6m spinning dash that knocks foes aside (6 damage, push 7). With the shield raised it's a Shield Charge: 4.2m behind the shield, invulnerable for its length, 10 damage and push 11 (into a wall or a foe: Crushed).

variants.hold: Raise the shield: 160 HP, regenerating; it blocks from the front and you walk slower.
variants.tap: Bash: a 2.6m cone, 12 damage, push 9 (into a wall or a foe: Crushed). Letting go after a block bashes too.
variants.air: Shield Surf: hold to block from the front while gliding.
variants.full: Guard 50+: Shield Slam, 18 damage, push 12 and stun 0.6 (spends 50).

e.name: Mending Ground
e.desc: Mark ground up to 7m away (or where your thrown mace lies): 1s later it bursts, healing allies inside 26 and mending your shield 60; foes inside are slowed.

r.name: Fissure
r.desc: A 0.5s unstoppable fuse, then a crack runs 14m forward (walls and rises stop it): 8 damage and stun 0.6 to everyone it passes. Then the line erupts in 3 pulses 0.3s apart (9 damage, slow 0.45 each); +1 pulse per 50 Guard, which it spends.

rank2.ult: Rank 2 (level 9): cooldown 110s -> 93.5s, +30% duration, +15% damage; Fissure reaches 17m.

rank_next.kin: Rank 3: cooldown 16s -> 12.8s, damage +30%; Mending Ground +0.5m and heals 10 more.
rank_next.dash: Rank 3: recharge 10s -> 7s; Whirl and Shield Charge +1m.

tells.half: three rune pips over the helm light at 33 / 66 / 100 Guard
tells.full: a gold crest light and a gold shield; a 0.3s shield flare before a Slam
